name: smwpatches-goal-sphere-triggers-secret-exit-on-extra-bit
title: Goal Sphere Triggers Secret Exit on Extra Bit
description:
The name of the patch should be pretty self-explanatory - it adds a secret exit functionality to the vanilla Goal Sphere (sprite 4A) if its extra bit is set.

You must use PIXI on your ROM at least once for this patch to work.

Requested by NopeContest.
